fun_facts: Jadarian Price is from Denison, Texas.
In three college seasons, Jadarian Price returned three kickoffs for touchdowns.
One of those scores was a 99-yard kickoff return touchdown against USC in 2023.
In 2025, Jadarian Price averaged 37.5 yards per kickoff return—the best in the FBS among players with at least 10 returns.
Across 41 games and three seasons at Notre Dame, Jadarian Price rushed for 1,692 yards and 21 touchdowns without making a start.

basis.reasoning: The NFL player profile lists Notre Dame as Jadarian Price’s college.
